notes.title: Change price, bug fixes and much more!
notes.notes:
PASKA BATTLE STYLE! has reached its first month of life, and well... it was a month. It's a game i hold dear in my heart, and i want people to see what it really can do, so i'm making the price a lot more affordable. On top of that, for those who were skeptical at first, i have released a demo with one level from the game so that you can make up your mind. 
Plus lots and lots of small bugs fixes.
Hoping for a good 2019, financially speaking. But you shouldn't care about that.
